card.name: Route and form words in dosing text
card.fires_on: Words that name a drug's route or dosage form, such as intravenous, orally, oral solution, film-coated tablet and delayed-release capsules, often partway through the word. Mostly in dosing and administration sentences.

modes.label: Route of administration
modes.description: Intravenous or oral wording right after a dose or drug name.
modes.example: 4 mg as a single-use intr<<avenous>> infusion over no less than 15

modes.label: Dosage form words
modes.description: Tablet, solution or capsule wording, often cut partway through the word.
modes.example: 400 mg film-co<<ated>> tablet orally, twice daily or 3

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are unrelated word pieces, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on words saying how a drug is given or what form it takes, like intravenous or oral tablet.
